definitions.explanation: A condition of high moisture in the air. Often used to describe climate or weather conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧{多湿|たしつ}だ。
examples.english: Japanese summers are hot and humid.

examples.japanese: {多湿|たしつ}な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カビ→カビ：07055_kabi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}え→生える：02392_haeru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Mold grows easily in humid environments.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一年中|いちねんじゅう}→一年中：17104_ichinenjuu⟧{多湿|たしつ}で、⟦{除湿機|じょしつき}→除湿機：06492_joshitsuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: This area is humid year-round, so a dehumidifier is essential.

notes:
{多湿|たしつ} combines {多|た} (much, many) and {湿|しつ} (moisture, humidity).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧{多湿|たしつ} (hot and humid — the most common collocation)
- {多湿|たしつ}な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ (humid environment)
- {多湿|たしつ}な⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧ (humid climate)

USAGE:
Most frequently appears in the set phrase ⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧{多湿|たしつ} to describe the characteristic summer climate of Japan. The antonym is ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧ (dry).
